headline: Turkey Warns EU Auto Exclusion Framework Risks 330,000 Domestic Jobs
summary: Turkish Trade Minister Ömer Bolat warned that excluding Turkey from the European Union's "Made in EU" automotive initiative threatens 330,000 jobs by 2035 and would drive up vehicle costs for European buyers.
why: Turkey is a strategic manufacturing base and supplier for major European automotive brands under the EU-Turkey Customs Union.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Exclusion from EU preference trade rules threatens Turkey's domestic automotive manufacturing exports.
